page_title: CRE 3-0 PIS | Cremonese v Pisa 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90' That's the end of the match.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

86' 3 - 0 David Okereke (Cremonese) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Adrian Semper is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
86' Cremonese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
85' Substitution. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sebastiano Luperto walks off.
84' A precise low pass is received by David Okereke (Cremonese), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
82' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
81' The percentage of ball possession is – 75:25.
79' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
77' The corner is swung in but Cremonese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is replacing Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
72' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) replacing Jamie Vardy.
72' The substitution has been made. David Okereke (Cremonese) has replaced Jari Vandeputte.
69' One of the players from Pisa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
69' Pisa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Oscar Hiljemark decides to make a substitution. Filip Stojilkovic will be replaced by Henrik Meister (Pisa).
65' That's the end of the game for Isak Vural, who is replaced by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa).
65' A spell of possession for Cremonese in an attempt to control the game.
62' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) makes a strong challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
59' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Youssef Maleh is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is coming onto the pitch as Giuseppe Pezzella cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' The game is interrupted now, Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:0.
54' Cremonese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
51' 2 - 0 Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
49' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) for his blatant foul.
48' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky!
45+1' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cremonese.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) commits a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
43' Cremonese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
41' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
39' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) makes a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Cremonese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Here is a change. Stefano Moreo is going off and Oscar Hiljemark gives the last tactical orders to Arturo Calabresi (Pisa).
37' Here comes a substitution. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris is given a rest as he is replaced by Samuele Angori (Pisa).
35' Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul after Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Giovanni Ayroldi saw the whole situation.
32' Isak Vural (Pisa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
31' 1 - 0 Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
28' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian Semper makes a comfortable save.
27' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cremonese.
26' Isak Vural (Pisa) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
23' RED CARD! Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi. He can have an early bath.
23' The free kick from long range, taken by Pisa, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
22' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
19' Cremonese couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Adrian Semper (Pisa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
18' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) was too forceful with his tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Cremonese have a free kick.
16' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
14' The game is interrupted. Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' The possession of the ball – 54:46.
11' Great teamplay by Cremonese as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Dangerous play by Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese). Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
6' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
4' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Cremonese will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi was nominated as the referee for this game.
